name: gaffer_apply
description: A revision-checked graph intent of 1 to 50 typed operations, applied with permission as one undo step (restored on failure): node.create {type or recipe, parent?, name?, bind?}, node.rename {target, name}, plug.set_value {target, value}, graph.connect {source, destination}, graph.connect_many {sources, destination, start_index?}, graph.delete {target}, output.define {target, name, file_name, ...}. render.start, render.cancel and ui.view are side effects, each the sole operation. expect: postconditions. For anything else, gaffer_execute_code.

if_revision.description: The revision of your last gaffer_context.

command_id.description: Idempotent ID: a replay applies nothing twice.

operations.description: {op, ...} with target, source, destination, sources, start_index, value, type, recipe, variant, name, parent, bind, renderer, file_name, driver, channels, frame_range, parameters as each operation needs. $alias names a node created earlier in the intent.

expect.description: {subject, predicate: exists, name_equals, value_equals, connected_to, value?}
